Hotels.mapAdminHelp: Map settings are independent of flight search. Custom maps need public HTTPS endpoints or same-origin /maps/ paths. List every resource origin. Do not enter secret keys. Saving does not contact the provider.
Hotels.mapProviderPrivacy: Opening the map connects your browser to {provider}. The service receives your IP address and map area; we do not send dates, prices or account details.
Hotels.mapDisabled: Maps are disabled in your account or instance settings.
Hotels.mapSettingsError: Map settings could not be loaded. Hotel search and tracking remain available.
Hotels.mapPreferenceHelp: Maps still load only when you open them. Your style applies to OpenFreeMap; custom providers use the administrator’s style.
Hotels.mapScope: Map the hotels in these results. Moving the map does not run a new search.
Hotels.mapPrivacy: Opening the map connects your browser to OpenFreeMap for map tiles. The service receives your IP address and the map area, but we do not send your dates, prices or account details.
Hotels.mapError: The map could not load completely. You can still compare and track every offer in the list.
Hotels.mapNoLocations: No verified hotel locations are available for this stay. All offers remain in the list.
Hotels.mapPrices: Pins show the lowest complete-stay price for the selected dates and room allocation. Select a hotel to compare its offers. Overlapping hotels are also selectable below.
Hotels.mapMissing: {count, plural, one {# offer has no verified map location} other {# offers have no verified map location}} and remains available in the list.
Hotels.mapSelected: Choose an offer to view its room details and policies in the list.
Hotels.historyScroll: Scroll sideways for room details and policies. Keyboard: focus the table and use the arrow keys.
Hotels.statusInterrupted: Status updates interrupted. Your search may still be running. Retry status updates or cancel the search.
Hotels.progress: {completed} of {total} checks complete. Tracking becomes available when the search finishes.
Hotels.googleSingleRoom: Google Hotels supports one room per search. Select Booking.com for multiple rooms.
Hotels.discoveryLimit: Up to 8 properties per provider per stay. Search for a hotel by name to focus your results.
Hotels.nearbyHelp: Arrival and departure shift independently; the number of nights may change.
Hotels.headline: A stay worth watching.
Hotels.intro: Find a hotel, compare complete stay prices, and follow the offers that fit your plans.

Hotels.reviewDetails: Review and edit the details before searching.

Hotels.searchingHelp: Checking providers. Detailed searches may take several minutes.

Hotels.noOffers: No offers matched these requirements. Adjust your dates or filters and search again.
